meta.description: Evaluate feature investments using revenue impact, cost structure, ROI, and strategy. Use when deciding whether a feature deserves investment.

copy.tagline: 评估功能投资回报，辅助决策是否投入资源
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要判断某个功能是否值得投入开发资源
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate feature investments to decide resource allocation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decide whether a feature deserves development investment

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你评估一个功能是否值得投资。它会问你关于收入影响、开发成本、ROI 和战略价值的问题，然后给出“建”、“不建”或“再验证”的建议，并附上计算依据。
howto.when: 当你需要决定是否要开发某个功能，尤其是涉及财务影响时触发。例如，当你问“我们应该建这个功能吗？”或提供功能描述和成本估算时。

say.text: 评估一下为中型市场客户建SSO功能是否值得。
say.note: Claude 会引导你提供收入、成本等信息，然后给出建议。
Claude 会询问收入连接、成本结构等，计算ROI并推荐。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through evaluating whether a feature is worth investing in. It asks about revenue impact, development cost, ROI, and strategic value, then gives build/don't build/validate recommendations with supporting math.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to decide whether to build a feature, especially with financial impact. For example, when you ask 'Should we build this feature?' or provide a feature description and cost estimates.

say_en.text: Evaluate whether building SSO for mid-market customers is worth it.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through revenue, cost, etc., and give a recommendation.

say_en.text: Help me analyze the ROI of an AI assistant feature.
